headnotes.text: Violation of a statute or ordinance supports a negligence claim only by a person within the class it was meant to protect. A municipal parking ordinance aimed at regulating vehicular traffic does not protect pedestrians, so parking on the wrong side of the street is not negligence toward a child pedestrian.
